I.value_zh: 现有 FCoP reference implementation、boundary.schema.json 的词表与四条规则、TeamConfig.roles 及 _role_labels、Project 写入路径、ADR-0015/0020 和既有测试、snapshot。
I.value_en: Existing FCoP reference implementation, boundary.schema.json vocabulary and four rules, TeamConfig.roles and _role_labels, Project write paths, ADR-0015/0020, tests, and snapshot.
I.notes_zh: 不读取引用制度正文以外的外部内容。
I.notes_en: No external material beyond stated references is read.

O.value_zh: boundary 模块、能力查询与校验、公开 Project 查询/断言方法、write_review 守门、配置 round-trip、测试、snapshot、ADR 状态、报告、归档与推送。
O.value_en: Boundary module, capability lookup and validation, public Project query/assert methods, write_review gate, configuration round-trip, tests, snapshot, ADR status, report, archive, and push.
O.notes_zh: 不把交付物视为已执行事实。
O.notes_en: Deliverables are not treated as executed facts.

A.value_zh: 以四轮提交新增能力词表与四规则校验，接入配置解析、Project API、write_review、测试、文档和归档。
A.value_en: Use four commits to add capability vocabulary and four-rule validation, then integrate config parsing, Project APIs, write_review, tests, documentation, and archive.
A.notes_zh: 动作不构成本审定的执行授权。
A.notes_en: Actions do not authorize adjudication execution.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 发起；ME 在 solo 模式执行；Reviewer 列出拒收边界。
P.value_en: ADMIN originates; ME executes in solo mode; Reviewer lists rejection boundaries.
P.notes_zh: 不从角色或 solo 模式推导权限。
P.notes_en: No authority is inferred from role or solo mode.

R.value_zh: 原文未给出本任务的执行期限或资源预算；第 2/7 抽象与四轮提交属范围和计划，测试数量、十一项验收及红 pytest 禁提交属质量与完成条件。
R.value_en: The source gives no execution deadline or resource budget for this task; the second of seven abstractions and four commits define scope and plan, while test counts, eleven criteria, and the ban on committing red pytest results define quality and completion.
R.notes_zh: 数量、测试与禁止条件仍在交付、完成条件和形式模型中，不改动原文事实。
R.notes_en: Counts, tests, and prohibitions remain in delivery, completion, and the formal model without changing source facts.

V.value_en: ADR-0020, ADR-0015, ADR-0001, ADR-0003, ADR-0010, TASK-004, TASK-007, TASK-008, and v1.0/v1.1 boundaries.
V.notes_zh: 仅保留文本引用，不验证其外部真实性。
V.notes_en: Textual references are retained without external verification.

C.value_zh: A1–A11：模块与导出、三层默认能力、查找和四规则、公开错误/方法、write_review 守门、配置无损、snapshot、报告、归档、提交和推送；并要求所有 pytest 为绿。
C.value_en: A1–A11: module and exports, three layer defaults, lookup and four rules, public error/methods, write_review gate, lossless configuration, snapshot, report, archive, commits and push; all pytest must be green.
C.notes_zh: 验收条件不是完成证据。
C.notes_en: Acceptance conditions are not completion evidence.

B.value_zh: 不得引入 Role dataclass、改变 TeamConfig.roles 类型、给 write_task/write_report/write_issue 强制接 boundary、改变 ADR 正文（Status 除外）、新增边界规则、改变 BoundaryViolation 字段、提交红 pytest；v1.0 不实现事件、迁移、报告警告和自定义 token 注册。
B.value_en: Do not introduce Role dataclass, change TeamConfig.roles type, force boundary on write_task/write_report/write_issue, change ADR text except Status, add boundary rules, change BoundaryViolation fields, or commit red pytest; events, migration, report warnings, and custom token registration are excluded from v1.0.
B.notes_zh: UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY warning 是唯一补充规则，但其表示与冻结字段发生冲突。
B.notes_en: UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY warning is the sole extra rule, but its representation conflicts with frozen fields.
